name: frailty_cox_replication
title: Replication of Cox Frailty Partial Likelihood including Frailties
description: Cox proportional hazards model with a shared log-normal frailty per patient and a flat prior on the regression coefficients. Replication of McGilchrist and Aisbett (1991).
added_by: Isac Kanon, Julius Searancke, Thauri Dattadeen
